Field Descriptions

REC_MAGIC_STRING_1 - Recovery protocol magic string 1

ASCII bytes 4-7 of the OCP RECV magic string. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Static read-only constant: the RDL reset is the single source of truth (no hw drive).
